items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I remember when Glenn Miller come about. The people was saying that Glenn Miller was the greatest band in the world

ctx.x: about No. 3. It didn't lose any quality, in fact, it was getting better and better, because those Tico recordings and Continental recordings that weren't on the Tico label, were great and they sold. The proof is "El Jamaiquino", "Minoso al Bate", the cha cha cha recordings of "La Paella" and "Sopa de Pichon", "Quimbombo", "El Niche", these became monsters and these are the ones that the dancers wanted to hear at the Palladium. Now, even though these recordings were just as good and danceable as the great things…

Is possible, but I don't think so. Is possible, but I don't think so. It's just a matter -- ahhh People liked new personalities. You could be the best -- it's like in fighting, in boxing; a new personality. You see now all the talk about Duran and Leonard. Leonard is a new personality. Duran is a great fighter, he was considered the best in this decade. It must be a reason why. It wasn't me or my wife that say that he is a good fighter, no, the connoisseur, the greatest people in the sport business consider Duran…

without respect the opinion of everybody that was listening to the band. But what about Benny Goodman, what about Artie Shaw? They was good bands too, top bands. But he come back with a new sound, a very understandable sound, and he just got the attention of the people.
